scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p ml2drender-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm && mkdir -p packages/ml2drender/wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/ml2drender_wasm.wasm packages/ml2drender/wasm/
scripts.test:python: uv run --project crates/python --reinstall-package ml2drender python -m unittest discover crates/python/tests
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked --workspace -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p ml2drender-wasm --locked -- -D warnings && uv run --project crates/python --only-group lint ruff check crates/python && uv run --project crates/python --only-group lint ruff format --check crates/python
